(rule!
  (for/fold ([out g]) ([obj (in-list (filter (lambda (o) (and (= (obj-color o) 4) (= (obj-size o) 3))) (objects g 0)))])
    (let* ((rs (remove-duplicates (map first (obj-cells obj))))
           (cs (remove-duplicates (map second (obj-cells obj)))))
      (cond [(= (length rs) 1)
             (let* ((r (first rs))
                    (lo (apply min cs))
                    (hi (apply max cs)))
               (if (and (= (- hi lo) 2) (= (length cs) 3))
                   (foldl (lambda (c acc)
                            (if (and (in-bounds? r c (rows g) (cols g)) (= (at g r c) 0))
                                (set-cell acc r c 8)
                                acc))
                          out
                          (list (- lo 1) (+ hi 1)))
                   out))]
            [(= (length cs) 1)
             (let* ((c (first cs))
                    (lo (apply min rs))
                    (hi (apply max rs)))
               (if (and (= (- hi lo) 2) (= (length rs) 3))
                   (foldl (lambda (r acc)
                            (if (and (in-bounds? r c (rows g) (cols g)) (= (at g r c) 0))
                                (set-cell acc r c 8)
                                acc))
                          out
                          (list (- lo 1) (+ hi 1)))
                   out))]
            [else out]))))
